sloka: चम्पक अशोक पुम्नाग साल ताल समाकुला ।तमाल वन संचन्ना नाग माला समावृता ।। ६-३९-३।।
transliteration: campaka aśoka pumnāga sāla tāla samākulā ।tamāla vana saṁcannā nāga mālā samāvṛtā ।। 6-39-3।।

translations.english: Thickly covered with trees like Champaka, Asoka, Punnaga, Sala, Tala, Samala and Tamala trees concealing the woods, surrounded with Nagamala trees all over and Hintala, Arjuna and Neepa in full bloom, Saptaparni, Tilaka, Karnakara and Patala trees with crests laden with flowers, intertwined with creepers and wonderful variety of flowers trees with tender red leaves as if clothe d in red, flowers of diverse kind and similarly colourful Neela and Sadala as king of forest, it was shining like Amaravathi, capital of Indra.
translations.hindi: वे वन उपवन चम्पा, अशोक, मौलसिरी, साखू और ताड़ वृक्षों से परिपूण थे और तमाल के वृक्षा के वन से ब्याप्त और नागकेसर के पेड़ों से घिरे हुए थे
